description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating at least four artifact tokens due to Ojer Taq and Anointed Procession.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping four artifact tokens, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
